newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Costello says FBT here to stay.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Costello says FBT here to stay.

text.p: The fringe benefits tax system is here to stay, Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday.

Asked at a business luncheon "when are the federal government going to remove fringe benefits tax?", Costello replied: "I don't think you'll ever be able to remove fringe benefits tax completely. You'll just be inviting salary repackaging particularly in relation to payment of expense accounts. It also wouldn't be fair to PAYE (pay as you earn) taxpayers and it would open up a very big hole in the tax base."
